name: osv-advisory-mcp-server
description: Query OSV.dev for package vulnerabilities, batch-audit dependency lists, and fetch full advisory records via MCP. STDIO or Streamable HTTP.

interface.shortDescription: Query OSV.dev for package vulnerabilities, batch-audit dependency lists, and fetch full advisory records via MCP. STDIO or Streamable HTTP.
interface.longDescription: Read-only access to the OSV.dev vulnerability database over MCP. Check a package version by tuple or PURL with osv_query_package, audit up to 1000 mixed package identifiers with osv_query_batch, and query a full Git commit hash with osv_query_commit. Fetch full advisory records with osv_get_vulnerability and valid ecosystem identifiers with osv_list_ecosystems. Keyless and public; CVE aliases chain to nist-nvd-mcp-server for CVSS scoring and CISA KEV status. Runs over STDIO or Streamable HTTP.
